exposure: Transdermal nitroglycerine patch (10 mg per 24 hours)
outcome: Uterine artery systolic and diastolic ratio (S/D), Pulsatility Index (PI), and Resistivity Index (RI)
Umbilical artery S/D, PI, and RI
cohort: 80 pregnant women with fetal growth restriction (FGR) with or without pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) and altered waveform velocimetry in uterine, umbilical, and fetal middle cerebral arteries
finding: Transdermal nitroglycerine improved both maternal and fetoplacental haemodynamics in pregnant women with chronic placental insufficiency.
